legacy_root.answer: Via RegisteringWriter.emit: no. After a full writer run the mechanical set difference disk-minus-manifest is the empty set (unregistered_count=0). Via a direct file open that skips the writer: yes, and the read-only reconciliation sweep reports that path as unregistered (count=1, path='sneak-bypass.txt'). Registration is performed inside emit() (manifest re-read from disk before reconcile). The sweep detects; it does not register.
legacy_root.inputs_note: Catalog input command-center/ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json is the charter thirteen-file index (absent on this tree). Condition 11 for unit outputs is emit-time registration into a writer-owned manifest, not a later tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --write sweep. Dependency receipts IMP-0434/IMP-0415 are absent; this unit ships the registering writer rather than wrapping a missing IMP-0434 module.
